mapper.select: select watchlist_id, user_id, stock_code, stock_name, create_by, create_time from stock_watchlist where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc
select count(1) > 0 from stock_watchlist where user_id = #{userId} and stock_code = #{stockCode}
mapper.insert: insert into stock_watchlist (user_id, stock_code, stock_name, create_by, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from stock_watchlist where watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} and user_id = #{userId}
